# claudectl

> The workspace layer for Claude Code. A terminal UI and desktop GUI that give Claude Code
> persistent per-project memory, a browsable and searchable session archive, MCP server
> awareness, an interactive architecture graph and per-project launch control. Pure Python
> standard library, zero runtime dependencies, MIT licensed. Runs on Windows, macOS and
> Linux; Windows-first.

claudectl does not replace Claude Code — it configures and launches it, and maintains the
project context between sessions. It uses your existing Claude Code authentication.

## Docs

- [Install](https://babarmuhammad.github.io/claudectl/install/): requirements and setup. Not on PyPI yet; clone and run, or `pip install -e .`.
- [Usage](https://babarmuhammad.github.io/claudectl/usage/): screens, full key bindings and the command line.
- [Features](https://babarmuhammad.github.io/claudectl/features/): sessions, MCP servers, agents, project memory, architecture graph, multi-account support, Plan to Execute, hooks, status line, desktop GUI.
- [Token economy](https://babarmuhammad.github.io/claudectl/token-economy/): how it reduces per-message context cost — bounded index, path-scoped rules, task-scoped injection, economy model routing.
- [Reference](https://babarmuhammad.github.io/claudectl/reference/): per-project files, workspace status, CLAUDE.md auto-generation, session encoding, file layout.
- [API reference](https://babarmuhammad.github.io/claudectl/api/): the local HTTP API the desktop GUI is built on, generated from the route tables.
- [FAQ](https://babarmuhammad.github.io/claudectl/faq/): platform support, dependencies, multiple accounts, how it differs from /resume.
- [Compare](https://babarmuhammad.github.io/claudectl/compare/): honest comparison against bare Claude Code, hand-written CLAUDE.md and terminal multiplexers, including what claudectl does not do.
- [Troubleshooting](https://babarmuhammad.github.io/claudectl/troubleshooting/): common problems and fixes.
- [Changelog](https://babarmuhammad.github.io/claudectl/changelog/): release history.

## Optional

- [Source](https://github.com/babarmuhammad/claudectl): the repository.
